title: The Full Ledger Query
flavorText: Master challenge: combine WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY and LIMIT in a single query — the full aggregation toolkit.
narrative: Final case: identify the top 2 months for Electronics sales, from months with more than one transaction, ordered by revenue.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, month TEXT NOT NULL, product TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL);
seedSql: INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1,'Jan','Datapad','Electronics',3,899.97),(2,'Jan','Power Cell','Electronics',10,199.90),(3,'Feb','Datapad','Electronics',5,1499.95),(4,'Feb','Logic Board','Electronics',2,179.98),(5,'Mar','Optic Lens','Optics',1,149.99),(6,'Mar','Servo Motor','Robotics',4,220.00),(7,'Mar','Datapad','Electronics',2,599.98),(8,'Apr','Power Cell','Electronics',20,399.80),(9,'Apr','Logic Board','Electronics',5,449.95),(10,'Apr','Steel Cable','Hardware',50,425.00);
task: Find the top 2 months for Electronics revenue, only including months with more than 1 Electronics transaction.

hints.text: WHERE category = 'Electronics' → GROUP BY month → HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 → ORDER BY elec_revenue DESC → LIMIT 2
SELECT month, SUM(amount) AS elec_revenue FROM sales WHERE category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY month HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY elec_revenue DESC LIMIT 2;
SELECT month, SUM(amount) AS elec_revenue FROM sales WHERE category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY month HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY elec_revenue DESC LIMIT 2;
